test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To burn the midnight oil

options.text: To stay up late working or studying

solution:
The correct answer is Option (2) i.e. **'To stay up late working or studying'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To **"burn the midnight oil": **To work late into the night or during the hours when most people are sleeping, especially to study or complete a task. (रात में देर तक काम करना या पढ़ाई करना, खासकर कोई काम पूरा करने या पढ़ाई करने के लिए)

 
 
• **Example**: She had to burn the midnight oil for weeks to prepare for her final exams.
 
 
 
• **'To stay up late working or studying': **(रात में देर तक काम करना या पढ़ाई करना) 
 
• This option 2 directly reflects the idiom's meaning related to dedicating oneself to work or study late into the night.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'To stay up late working or studying'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **To waste time: **This suggests inefficiently using time, which does not correspond with the focused, hard work implied by burning the midnight oil.
 
• **To overthink:** While overthinking can happen at any time, the idiom specifically refers to the action of working or studying late, not the thought processes involved.
 
• **To be relaxed and calm: **This state is opposite to the action and intent implied by burning the midnight oil, which involves active effort and potentially stressful work or study.
